entities.name: Activation of the Mox Beacon
entities.description: Event on Corondor in 4196 AR in which Ravidel's beacon called planeswalkers to Corondor.

entities.name: Corondor
entities.description: Land of Dominaria where the event occurred.

entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: Hero who opposes Ravidel and whose spark ignites, letting him planeswalk.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: Antagonist serving Taysir of Rabiah who activates the Mox Beacon.

entities.name: Kristina of the Woods
entities.description: Ally of Jared and former lover of Taysir.

entities.name: Caliphear
entities.description: Ally of Jared unsummoned by Ravidel.

entities.name: Altair of Coloni
entities.description: Ally of Jared who sacrifices himself to destroy a demon.

entities.name: Dueling Chasm of Golthonor
entities.description: Chasm created when the dragon Piru was destroyed in battle with Dakkon Blackblade.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: Devastating artifact destroyed by Jared's Shatter spell.

entities.name: Rust Daggers
entities.description: Daggers Jared uses to cast Shatter.

entities.name: Taysir of Rabiah
entities.description: Powerful planeswalker, Ravidel's master and Kristina's former lover.

entities.name: Hoont
entities.description: Spitting slug ally of Jared, slain by the Lord of the Pit.

entities.name: Lord of the Pit
entities.description: Demon summoned by Ravidel and destroyed by Altair.

entities.name: Moxen
entities.description: Three powerful artifacts carried by Kristina and used by Ravidel.

entities.name: Mox Beacon
entities.description: Spell sending a call across the Blind Eternities that draws planeswalkers.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: Space between planes.

entities.name: Planeswalkers' War
entities.description: Coming conflict on Corondor.

entities.name: Daria
entities.description: Adopted daughter of Taysir who guides Jared's spark.

entities.name: Quirion
entities.description: Place of ancient wisdom and refuge where Jared and Kristina emerge.

entities.name: Dakkon Blackblade
entities.description: Planeswalker who fought Piru.

entities.name: Piru
entities.description: Dragon destroyed in battle with Dakkon.

events.summary: Jared and allies travel to the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor to make a stand against Ravidel.
events.quote: where Jared and his companions would make their stand against Ravidel

events.summary: Jared uses the Rust Daggers to cast Shatter on the Golgothian Sylex, destroying it.
events.quote: destroying it and preventing the annihilation of Corondor

events.summary: Caliphear is unsummoned by Ravidel; Ravidel reveals his master is Taysir of Rabiah.
events.quote: his master was none other than Taysir of Rabiah

events.summary: Hoont is slain by Ravidel's Lord of the Pit; Altair sacrifices himself to destroy the demon.
events.quote: Altair of Coloni sacrificed himself to destroy the demon

events.summary: Ravidel seizes the three Moxen and activates the Mox Beacon, drawing planeswalkers to Corondor.
events.quote: Ravidel seized the three Moxen that Kristina had carried

events.summary: Jared destroys the pillar under Ravidel, who plummets into the chasm.
Daria arrives and Jared's spark ignites; he planeswalks for the first time, taking Kristina with him.
Jared and Kristina emerge near Quirion to prepare for the Planeswalkers' War.

relations.quote: his master was none other than Taysir of Rabiah
